name: glare-hover
title: Glare Hover
description: A diagonal glare that sweeps across its content on hover, driven by CSS variables (angle, size, duration, colour).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper (use `rounded-*` to match the content).

props.name: angle
props.description: Angle of the glare in degrees.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the glare tile as a percentage of the element.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the sweep in milliseconds.

props.name: playOnce
props.description: Only animate while hovered — the glare snaps back instead of sweeping out.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional CSS width of the wrapper.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional CSS height of the wrapper.
